subject: Stakeholder map & Mutual Action Plan (MAP) - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@finpay.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-21T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Stakeholder map & Mutual Action Plan (MAP) - post-call recap

Alex — great chat today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned:

Summary:
- Use case: real-time support routing and summarization for FinPay Merchant Ops team (high throughput, PII redaction required).
- Key decision criteria: latency <150ms tail for generate endpoint, SOC2 evidence, and predictable unit economics for peak month.

Stakeholder map (from today’s call):
- Product: Priya Singh (day-to-day champion)
- Security/Compliance: TBD (you mentioned a central security reviewer)
- Procurement: procurement@finpay.com (you said they handle SOW + PO)
- Economic buyer: likely VP of Ops (you said Alex K will approve budget)

Proposed MAP (draft milestones):
1) Share technical benchmark and runtime profile — Redwood to provide (by 2027-03-24)
2) Security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence — FinPay to confirm reviewer, Redwood sends artifacts (by 2027-03-28)
3) SOW + pricing term review — exchange drafts (by 2027-04-04)
4) Pilot kickoff (2 weeks) — target week of 2027-04-18

Immediate asks for you:
- Confirm who owns security review and procurement contact (name + email).
- Confirm timing/expectation for VP of Ops budget approval (approx date).

I attached a short MAP template and our standard SOW template for reference (internal names below). I’ll follow up with a Drive link for the MAP.

Attachments: FinPay-SOW-template.docx, FinPay-MAP-template.xlsx

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Alex Johnson <alex@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@finpay.com>
Date: 2027-03-21T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stakeholder map & Mutual Action Plan (MAP) - post-call recap

Thanks Marissa — good summary. A few clarifications: 

1) Security reviewer: Priya is the product lead but security review is handled by our InfoSec team — primary reviewer is Marcus Lee (marcus.lee@finpay.com). Please send the SOC2 + architecture diagram to him and cc Priya.

2) Procurement: procurement@finpay.com is correct; primary contact is Sarah Lowe (sarah.lowe@finpay.com).

3) Economic buyer: Confirmed — Alex Klein (VP Ops) will be the budget approver. We expect a decision window by mid-April after the pilot.

Happy to get the MAP and SOW. We prefer to see security artifacts before legal starts redlines.

- Alex
Head of Solutions | FinPay

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@finpay.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@finpay.com>, Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@finpay.com>
Date: 2027-03-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stakeholder map & Mutual Action Plan (MAP) - post-call recap

Appreciate the quick confirm, Alex — added Marcus and Sarah to keep things moving. Camila (solutions engineer) and Mateo (CS lead) are looped to own the technical benchmark and pilot scope.

Updated MAP (dates tentative):
- 2027-03-24: Redwood to send runtime profile + short benchmark (Camila)
- 2027-03-26: Redwood to send SOC2 extract + architecture diagram (Marissa) — will cc Marcus
- 2027-03-29: FinPay security feedback call (15-30m) to unblock legal; propose 9am PT.
- 2027-04-04: Exchange SOW draft and pricing — Sarah to join legal/procurement thread.
- 2027-04-18: Pilot kickoff (2-week pilot)

Camila — can you confirm benchmark scope (latency & sample PII redaction tests)? Mateo — will work with you on pilot success criteria and instrumentation for cost tracking.

I uploaded a working MAP doc to the shared Drive and added milestone owners. Link below. I’m also attaching our security questionnaire and SOW template to this thread for Sarah/Marcus to review.

Attachments: FinPay-security-questionnaire.pdf, FinPay-SOW-template.docx
Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAPSharedLink

Marissa

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alex Johnson <alex@finpay.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-22T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stakeholder map & Mutual Action Plan (MAP) - post-call recap

Quick note — scope for the benchmark:
- 100 concurrent requests, sequence length 256 tokens, measuring p95/p99 latency and per-token cost.
- PII redaction: we'll run a small sample dataset (anonymized) and show before/after outputs + redaction log.

Deliverables I'll provide by 2027-03-24:
1) Benchmark report (CSV + short summary)
2) Runtime profile (expected tail latencies on our Dedicated offering)
3) Instructions for integrating test keys and instrumentation for cost metrics

Attaching the SOW template we typically start from. Sarah/Security team — happy to tailor.

Attachment: FinPay-SOW-template.docx

Camila
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Stakeholder map & Mutual Action Plan (MAP) - confirmation and next actions

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation of next actions and owners: 
- 2027-03-24 (Camila): benchmark + runtime profile (deliver to Marcus + cc Alex/Priya).
- 2027-03-26 (Marissa): SOC2 extract + architecture diagram (deliver to Marcus).
- 2027-03-29 (Alex + Marcus + Marissa + Camila): 15m security sync (proposed 9am PT) — I'll send calendar invite.
- 2027-04-04 (Sarah + Marissa): Exchange SOW and pricing draft.

I’ve updated the MAP in Drive with these milestones and added the HubSpot deal link in the doc. If those dates look good I’ll schedule the security sync and set the pilot kickoff goal for 2027-04-18.

Next: I’ll send the Drive MAP invite and the calendar for the security sync today.
